comment: Driver packages injected offline into install.wim (and, where marked, boot.wim index 2 so Windows Setup sees the disk). Official vendor URLs only, pinned by sha256. Zero egress means Windows Update never runs on the laptop, so every driver the laptop needs must be in the image.

AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.8.1 (WHQL, Recommended) for Windows 11, package -b (Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S product page)
packages.sha256_source: AMD publishes none; pinned from the CI probe download of 2026-10-06 (930,653,064 bytes)
packages.headers_reason: drivers.amd.com redirects requests without a Referer to amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/Download-Incomplete.html, which tells download-manager users to send an HTTP referrer.
